project_type: Flutter mobile app (Supabase backend) for home management, Spanish UI, non-technical user
build_system: Flutter SDK at ~/flutter_sdk (pinned 3.47.6, Dart 3.13.5). pubspec SDK ^3.11.1. dart format uses tall style.
test_framework: flutter_test. Pure-logic unit tests live in test/*_test.dart (e.g. shopping_celebration_test.dart, task_pool_test.dart).
build_command: export PATH="$HOME/flutter_sdk/bin:$PATH"; export FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true; flutter pub get; flutter analyze
test_command: export PATH="$HOME/flutter_sdk/bin:$PATH"; export FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true; flutter test
verification_instructions: Reproduce CI EXACTLY (note the trailing dot): 1) `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .` -> must report 0 changed. 2) `flutter analyze` -> 'No issues found!'. 3) `flutter test` -> all green (baseline main = 281 tests; must NOT drop below). 4) `dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart --check`; if it fails, regenerate with `dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart` and commit docs/architecture/dependency-map.md. If a migration is added, CI also validates filename NNNN_nombre.sql, balanced parens, ends with ';'. The 'revision manual (RLS/auth)' workflow fails on purpose for RLS/policy changes but does NOT block (alter publication is not RLS). After `flutter pub get`, discard autogenerated changes: `git checkout -- pubspec.lock analysis_options.yaml` and any plugin registrants under linux/macos/windows and .flutter-plugins-dependencies.
snapshot_or_generated_files: docs/architecture/dependency-map.md is generated and guarded by `dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart --check`. Regenerate with `dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart` and commit if the guard fails. New files in lib/ that add imports will change this map.
setup_instructions: SDK already present at ~/flutter_sdk. Run: export PATH="$HOME/flutter_sdk/bin:$PATH"; export FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true; flutter pub get. Then discard autogenerated edits with git checkout --.
environment_constraints: Sandbox network: repository access only / common deps. Flutter SDK pre-cloned at ~/flutter_sdk; do NOT re-clone. No Supabase instance available: realtime cannot be exercised at runtime, so verification is format+analyze+test+dependency-map guard only. Realtime network logic depends on Supabase.instance.client and is NOT unit-testable; only PURE helper logic (event reconciliation / own-echo detection) is testable.
contribution_requirements: design-system.md: PROHIBIDO el termino 'IA'/'AI'/'modelo'/'GPT'/'Gemini' en texto visible. Radio 16 (AppRadius.md) en tarjetas/modales/botones/campos incl. SnackBar. Usar tokens del tema (AppColors incl. inkMuted; NUNCA Colors.grey[xxx] ni literales 0xFF). Espanol cercano, no tecnicismos. Honrar reduce-motion (MediaQuery.disableAnimations) si se anima. security.md: RLS por home_id ya restringe los datos; no exponer datos entre hogares; el filtro realtime por home_id es defensa en profundidad.
key_patterns: Both target screens are StatefulWidget with FutureBuilder + a _reload() that re-runs the fetch and setState. Models (ShoppingListItem.fromMap, HomeTask.fromMap) are null-tolerant. _homeId()/profile home_id lookup resolves the household. Pure-logic helpers live in lib/utils/ with matching tests in test/ (see lib/utils/shopping_celebration.dart + test/shopping_celebration_test.dart as the template: a pure top-level function plus a small stateful gate class, both fully unit-tested). supabase_flutter ^2.17.2 is present; Realtime (channel/stream/onPostgresChanges) is currently UNUSED (0 occurrences). SnackBar error pattern today uses backgroundColor: Colors.red; the new silent realtime error SnackBar must instead use a card look: RoundedRectangleBorder radius 16, behavior floating, friendly Spanish text, shown ONCE (no spam).
relevant_files: lib/shopping_list_screen.dart (shopping list, embedded in DespensaTab; _fetch/_reload, _toggleChecked/_addToPantry, Dismissible, confetti via ShoppingCelebrationGate, aisle grouping slivers)
lib/tasks_screen.dart (Tareas tab, direct IndexedStack child; _load/_reload, _claim -> TaskScheduler.claimAndComplete, Bolsa Comun pool, points gating via HomeModule.points)
lib/main_shell.dart (IndexedStack: TasksScreen is always-alive; DespensaTab -> ShoppingListScreen also always-alive. Screens in background keep subscriptions.)
lib/models/shopping_list_item.dart (fromMap tolerant; id, home_id, checked, source...)
lib/models/task.dart (HomeTask.fromMap tolerant; id, home_id, assigned_to, is_done, isInPool getter)
lib/utils/shopping_celebration.dart (TEMPLATE for pure helper + stateful gate)
directory_structure: lib/ (screens at root incl. shopping_list_screen.dart, tasks_screen.dart, main_shell.dart; lib/models, lib/services, lib/utils, lib/theme, lib/widgets, lib/tabs). test/ (unit + widget tests). supabase/migrations/ (NNNN_nombre.sql, latest 0042). tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart. docs/architecture/dependency-map.md (generated). .github/workflows/ci.yml + ai-development.yml.
